DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。入金のお手伝いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Would you like help making a deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行事で集めた現金を入れたいです。集計メモより封筒の中が多い気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行事現金の実物が集計メモより多い疑いがあるため入金前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to deposit cash collected at an event. I think there is more in the envelope than the total on my tally note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese, before making the deposit, that you suspect the actual event cash exceeds the total on your tally note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込金額を確定する前に、現金と記録を確認してください。多い理由は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the cash and your records before finalizing the amount on the deposit form. Do you know why there might be extra money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の買物用の千円を、一時的に同じ封筒へ入れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の買物用千円を一時的に同封した可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I may have temporarily put a thousand yen of my own shopping money in the same envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you may have temporarily put your own thousand yen for shopping in the same envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行では行事のお金か私物かを判定できません。ご自身の記録と分けて確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bank cannot determine whether money belongs to the event or to you personally. Can you check it separately against your own records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付表と財布のメモを照合します。今は封筒ごと入金しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付表と本人メモの照合まで封筒全体の入金を待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will compare the event registration sheet with the note in my wallet. Please do not deposit the whole envelope yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the deposit of the whole envelope to wait until you have compared the registration sheet with your personal note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ受付は進めません。確認のための台をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will not proceed with processing yet. I will show you a counter where you can check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の千円が混ざっていました。抜いた後、行事の集計額と現金が一致しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の千円を除いて行事集計と現金が一致したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My thousand yen was mixed in. After removing it, the cash matched the event's total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that, after removing your own thousand yen, the cash matches the event tally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した額で申込書をご記入ください。入金先も本人の管理する口座か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please fill in the form with the amount you have checked. We will also check whether the receiving account is one you manage yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 集計と合った金額だけ申し込みます。自分の千円は財布へ戻し、控えは行事の記録と保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一致した額だけ本人管理口座へ入れ私物千円を戻して控えを行事記録に残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will apply to deposit only the amount that matches the tally. I will put my own thousand yen back in my wallet and keep the deposit record with the event records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will deposit only the matching amount into an account you manage, put back your own thousand yen, and keep the deposit record with the event records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込額と入金先を確認します。現金はこちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the requested amount and destination account. Please place the cash here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会計でお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋は一枚なのに、画面には二枚あります。まだ支払っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払前の画面で袋が二枚だが実物は一枚だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one bag, but the screen shows two. I have not paid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the screen shows two bags before payment, but you actually have only one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初に画面で袋を選びましたか。その後で店員から受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you select a bag on the screen first, then receive one from a staff member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。画面で一枚を選び、店員さんにも一枚くださいと言いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面で一枚選んだ後店員にも一枚を頼んだ経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I selected one on the screen, then also asked the staff member for one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you selected one bag on the screen and then also asked a staff member for one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加分が重なっていますね。一枚を取り消します。商品にも気になる行はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The additional entry has been duplicated. I will cancel one. Are there any product lines you are concerned about too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋以外は合っています。商品は取り消さず、袋だけ直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品明細は正しいため袋の重複だけを取り消してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Everything except the bag is correct. Please leave the products as they are and correct only the bag entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for only the duplicate bag entry to be canceled because the product details are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋を一枚にしました。合計額が変わったので、表示をもう一度ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have changed it to one bag. The total has changed, so please check the display again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚になりました。袋を受け取っても、もう一度商品として読ませる必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正後一枚になったことを確認し袋を再度読み取らないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It shows one now. Even though I have received the bag, I do not need to scan it again as an item, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the corrected quantity is one, and ask whether you should avoid scanning the bag again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この会計では袋を登録済みです。そのまま支払いへ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right. The bag is already registered in this transaction. You can proceed directly to payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を追加で読ませず、この合計額で払います。訂正をありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を追加登録せず訂正後の合計額で払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay this total without scanning the bag again. Thank you for correcting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will pay the corrected total without adding another bag entry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそありがとうございます。レシートを忘れずお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you too. Please remember to take your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。休憩室でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem in the rest area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘を持って入ったら、入口の床に水が垂れてしまいました。拭く物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持込んだ濡れ傘で床を濡らしたため拭く物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I brought my umbrella inside, water dripped onto the floor by the entrance. Is there anything I can use to wipe it up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the wet umbrella you brought in dripped on the floor, and ask for something to wipe it with.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 清掃を手配します。濡れた範囲を示してください。誰か滑ったりされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will arrange cleaning. Please show me which area is wet. Has anyone slipped?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口のマットからこの椅子までです。誰かが滑ったところは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口から椅子までの範囲を示し滑った人は見ていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the mat at the entrance to this chair. I have not seen anyone slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the area from the entrance to the chair, and explain in Japanese that you have not seen anyone slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その区間を確認します。傘はこちらの受け皿付きの傘立てへ置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check that stretch of floor. You can put your umbrella in this stand with a drip tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 椅子に掛けるのはやめます。自分の傘に付いた札を見える向きで置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傘を椅子に掛けず本人の札が見える向きで傘立てへ置くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not hang it on the chair. I will put it in with the tag on my umbrella facing outward where I can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will put the umbrella in the stand instead of hanging it on a chair, with your own tag visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの傘と区別してください。水の付いた荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make sure you can distinguish it from the other umbrellas. Do you have any wet belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バッグの底も濡れています。椅子に置く前に、自分の布で拭きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 濡れたバッグ底を椅子へ置く前に自分の布で拭くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bottom of my bag is wet too. I will wipe it with my own cloth before putting it on a chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wipe the wet bottom of your bag with your own cloth before putting it on a chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。清掃中は濡れた入口を行き来せず、こちらの席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. While cleaning is in progress, please wait in this seat rather than walking back and forth through the wet entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 傘は傘立て、バッグは拭いて手元へ置きました。床の清掃が終わるまでここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傘とバッグの保管を整え清掃完了まで席で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put my umbrella in the stand, wiped my bag, and placed it by me. I will wait here until the floor has been cleaned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have arranged where to keep your umbrella and bag and will wait in your seat until cleaning is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 清掃担当へ連絡しました。ご申告ありがとうございます。ごゆっくりお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have contacted the cleaning staff. Thank you for letting us know. Please make yourself comfortable while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の切符を買う予定でしたが、友人が明日出発すると連絡してきました。私は今日のままです。買い方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人だけ翌日出発へ変更したため二人分の購入方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was planning to buy tickets for two, but my friend has told me they will leave tomorrow. I am still leaving today. I would like advice on buying the tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to buy the two people's tickets because only your friend has changed to a departure the next day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、本日はお客様一人でご利用ですね。お友達の明日の出発時刻は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then you will be traveling alone today. Has your friend decided what time to leave tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ決まっていません。仕事が終わってから来るそうですが、何時に終わるかわからないと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌日の友人の仕事終了時刻は未定と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. They say they will come after work, but do not know what time they will finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that your friend's finishing time at work tomorrow has not been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時刻を決めてから、お友達の切符を選ぶほうがよさそうですね。今日のお客様の行き先を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would seem better to choose your friend's ticket once the time is settled. Please tell me your destination for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの駅までです。友人の都合に合わせて自分まで明日に変える必要はないので、今日行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は今日のまま指定の駅へ行くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: To this station. I do not need to change my own trip to tomorrow to fit my friend's plans, so I will go today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will still go to the specified station today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の候補はこの二つです。早いほうは乗換えが一回、遅いほうは乗換えなしです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are two options for today. The earlier one requires one transfer, and the later one is direct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物が多いので、乗換えなしのほうをお願いします。到着を待つ家族にも遅いほうの時刻を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物が多いため遅い乗換えなしの候補を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a lot of luggage, so I would like the direct one. I will also tell my family waiting for me the later arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the later, direct option in Japanese because you have a lot of luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の一人分を、この乗換えなしの候補で購入しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you like to buy one ticket for today using this direct option?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、一人分だけお願いします。友人には仕事の終了時刻が決まってから自分の分を選ぶよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の一人分だけ購入し友人の分は時刻確定後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, just one ticket, please. I will tell my friend to choose their own ticket after they know when work will finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will buy only one ticket for today and leave your friend's ticket until their time is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。こちらの一枚です。お気をつけてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is your one ticket. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生活の相談に来ました。子どもを預けられず連れてきたのですが、一緒に座れるところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもを連れて生活相談できる席を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came for advice about daily living. I could not arrange childcare, so I brought my child with me. Is there somewhere we can sit together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a seat where you can receive advice about daily living with your child alongside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの相談席でしたら一緒に座れます。ご相談の内容を今この受付で詳しく伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can sit together at this consultation desk. Would you like me to ask about the details of your situation here at reception now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家庭の事情なので、ほかの方に聞こえる場所では詳しく話したくありません。相談席で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家庭の事情は公開の受付ではなく相談席で話したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It concerns my family, so I do not want to discuss the details where other people can hear. I would like to talk at the consultation desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to discuss your family situation at the consultation desk rather than at the public reception counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。内容は相談席で伺います。今日はどのくらいお時間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will hear the details at the consultation desk. How much time do you have today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分ほどです。子どもが落ち着かなくなったら、少し外へ出て戻ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分の時間と子どものための中断後再開について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: About thirty minutes. If my child becomes restless, may I step outside for a while and come back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have thirty minutes, and ask about taking a break for your child and resuming afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中で休む際は相談員へお声がけください。再開できる時間もその場でお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need to take a break, please let the adviser know. We will tell you then when the consultation can resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では最初に住まいの相談だけをします。仕事の話もありますが、今日は無理に全部話さないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住まいを優先して仕事の話は今回は後回しにすると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will start with just the housing issue. I also have a work issue, but I will not try to discuss everything today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you choose to prioritize housing and leave the work issue for another time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住まいの相談を優先ですね。必要な資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You would like to prioritize housing, then. Have you brought the necessary documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 賃貸の契約書を持っています。相談席で見せて、三十分の中で今日確認する点を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約書を相談席で示し今日確認する範囲を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my rental agreement. I would like to show it at the consultation desk and decide what to check today within the thirty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show the agreement at the consultation desk and want to decide the scope of what to check today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お子さんと一緒にこちらへどうぞ。相談員へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come this way with your child. I will hand you over to the adviser.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お会計について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having difficulty with payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計は四千二百円ですが、現金が三千円しかありません。このカードで払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四千二百円の会計に現金三千円しかなくカード払い可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bill is four thousand two hundred yen, but I only have three thousand yen in cash. Can I pay with this card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only have three thousand yen in cash for a four-thousand-two-hundred-yen bill, and ask whether you can pay by card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し訳ありませんが、こちらではそのカードを取り扱っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am sorry, but we do not accept that card here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 千二百円足りません。近くにいる友人が現金を届けてくれるそうなので、連絡してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 千二百円不足のため近くの友人に現金を届けてもらいたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am twelve hundred yen short. A friend nearby says they can bring me cash. May I contact them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are twelve hundred yen short and would like a friend nearby to bring cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。届くまでのお時間はどのくらいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. About how long will it take for them to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話で確認したら十五分ほどとのことです。受付の前に立ち続けず、待合の席で待ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人到着まで十五分ほど待合で待ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked by phone, and they said about fifteen minutes. May I wait in a seat in the waiting area instead of standing in front of reception the whole time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may wait in the waiting area for about fifteen minutes until your friend arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待合でお待ちください。お支払いはまだ完了していませんので、戻られた際にこの会計票をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait in the waiting area. Payment has not been completed yet, so please show this payment slip when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会計票は私が持ちます。友人が代わりに手続きするのではなく、現金を受け取って私が払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の代理支払いではなく本人が現金を受け取って払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the payment slip. My friend will not handle the procedure on my behalf; I will receive the cash and make the payment myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your friend will not pay on your behalf, but that you will receive the cash and pay yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。四千二百円のお会計はその時にお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will accept payment of the four thousand two hundred yen then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。友人から現金を受け取ったら、会計票を持ってこの窓口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計票を持って現金到着後に窓口へ戻ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Once I receive the cash from my friend, I will return to this counter with the payment slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will return to the counter with the payment slip after the cash arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。何か変わりましたら受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will be waiting. Please let reception know if anything changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先ほど車と自転車が接触するのを見ました。私は歩いていた目撃者で、事故の当事者ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 接触事故を見た歩行者で当事者ではないと名乗る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A little while ago, I saw a car and a bicycle collide. I was a pedestrian who witnessed it, not someone involved in the accident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Introduce yourself in Japanese as a pedestrian who witnessed the collision, not a party to the accident.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お越しいただきありがとうございます。場所と時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for coming. Could you tell me where and when it happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後三時ごろ、駅前の角です。私は道路の反対側で信号待ちをしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発生時刻と場所と自分の立ち位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around three in the afternoon, at the corner in front of the station. I was waiting at the traffic light on the opposite side of the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the time and place of the incident and where you were standing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見えた車や自転車の特徴をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the features of the car and bicycle you saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車は白、自転車は青でした。車の番号は読めませんでしたし、接触直前の信号の色も見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見えた車体色と確認できない番号や信号を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The car was white and the bicycle was blue. I could not read the car's number, and I did not see the color of the traffic light immediately before the collision.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the vehicle colors you saw from the number and traffic signal you could not confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見ていない点は不明として伺います。接触した位置をこの紙で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record what you did not see as unknown. Could you indicate on this sheet where the collision happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この角です。私が立っていたのは向かい側のここです。速かったかどうかは、距離があったので判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図で接触位置と自分の位置を示し速度は判断できないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: At this corner. I was standing here on the opposite side. I was too far away to judge whether they were going fast.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the collision location and your own position on the diagram, and explain in Japanese that you cannot judge the speed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。ほかの人から聞いた話と、ご自身が見たことは分けてお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will ask separately about what you heard from others and what you saw yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 誰が悪いかの話は聞きましたが、それは自分で確認していません。今説明した場所と色だけが私の目撃です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 責任の伝聞を自分の目撃事実に含めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I heard people talking about who was at fault, but I have not confirmed that myself. The location and colors I just described are the only things I personally witnessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not include what you heard about responsibility among the facts you witnessed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。実際にご覧になったこととして記録します。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record it as what you actually saw. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to send today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へポスターを送ります。折りたくないので筒に入れましたが、このままで発送できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折りたくないポスターを筒で送れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a poster to a friend. I put it in a tube because I do not want it folded. Can I send it like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can send a poster in a tube because you do not want it folded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 梱包の状態を確認します。両端のふたは外れないよう固定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the packaging. Are the caps at both ends secured so that they cannot come off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片方は差し込んだだけです。テープを持っていないので、ここで買える資材があれば使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片側のふたが未固定で梱包テープを購入したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One end is only pushed in. I do not have tape, so I would like to use packing materials if I can buy them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that one cap is not secured and you would like to buy packing tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 梱包用テープを販売しています。受付は固定し直してからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We sell packing tape. Let us accept the item after you secure it properly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つ買います。宛名の紙もありますが、筒のふたをまたぐ場所には貼らないほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: テープを買い宛名をふたの継ぎ目へ貼るべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy one. I have an address label too. Should I avoid sticking it across the tube's cap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will buy tape, and ask whether to put the address label over the joint of the cap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ふたが開く部分を避け、胴の見やすい場所へしっかり貼ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Avoid the part where the cap opens and stick it securely in a visible place on the body of the tube.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両端を留めて、宛名は胴へ貼りました。中身は紙のポスター一枚で、ほかの物は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両端固定と宛名貼付を終え中身はポスター一枚と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have secured both ends and stuck the address label on the body. There is one paper poster inside and nothing else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have secured both ends and attached the address, and declare that the contents are one poster.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では外側の長さと重さを確認して、利用できる発送方法と料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will check the outside length and weight and explain the available shipping methods and prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。折らない梱包のまま送れる方法を、料金を聞いてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 折らない梱包で利用できる方法と料金を聞いてから選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will choose a method that can send it in this packaging without folding it after hearing the prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will choose after hearing the available methods and prices for sending it in packaging that keeps it unfolded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。筒をこちらへお載せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please place the tube here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知の文字が小さくて読めません。残高ではなく、返答が必要な箇所をゆっくり読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の返答必要箇所だけをゆっくり読んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The print on this notice is too small for me to read. Could you slowly read the part that requires a response, rather than the balance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for only the part of the notice requiring a response to be read slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。ここには、登録情報を確認して、変更があれば窓口へ相談するよう書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. It says here to check your registered information and consult the counter if there are any changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。金額や口座番号をほかの方に聞こえるように読み上げるのは避けてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高と番号は周囲に聞こえるように読まないでほしいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Please avoid reading the amounts or account number aloud where other people can hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not want the balance or number read aloud within hearing of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その部分は読み上げません。登録情報はご本人確認後、個別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will not read that part aloud. Let us check your registered information privately after verifying your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。住所の文字も拡大できる形で見たいです。自分で確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録住所を自分で読める拡大表示の方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would also like to see my address in a format that can be enlarged. Is there anything I can check myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a way to enlarge the registered address so you can read it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる表示方法を担当に確認します。少しお待ちいただくため番号札をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the available display methods with the person in charge. There will be a short wait, so I will give you a numbered ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号の電光表示も見づらいです。札は持ちますので、呼ばれたらこの席へ声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号表示が見づらいため待機席への声掛けを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The electronic number display is difficult for me to see too. I will hold on to the ticket. Could someone come to this seat and tell me when my number is called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for someone to speak to you at your seat because the number display is difficult to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ、お席への声掛けを希望されていると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge that you would like to be notified at your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではここで待ちます。登録住所の確認と、見やすい表示方法を担当者に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席で待ち登録住所と見やすい表示を担当へ相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will wait here. I will ask the person in charge to check my registered address and discuss a display method that is easier to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will wait in your seat and discuss the registered address and an easier-to-read display with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当が準備できましたらお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will speak to you when the person in charge is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お困りでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った袋の持ち手が裂けました。中には瓶もあるので、ここで一度置いて詰め直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持ち手が裂けた袋を台に置き瓶の入った買物を詰め直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The handle of the bag I bought has torn. There are bottles inside too. May I put it down here for a moment and repack my shopping?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to put the bag with a torn handle on the counter and repack your shopping, which includes bottles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの台をお使いください。商品が落ちたり割れたりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this counter. Has anything fallen out or broken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 落ちる前に持ち直したので、瓶は割れていません。袋をもう一枚買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 瓶は落ちて割れていないと説明し新しい袋を買いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I caught it before anything fell, so the bottles are not broken. I would like to buy another bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the bottles have not fallen and broken, and that you want to buy a new bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一枚五円です。重い物を分けられるよう、二枚ご用意しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: They are five yen each. Would you like two so you can separate the heavy items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予備の袋は一枚で大丈夫です。空の布袋を持っているので、瓶はそちらへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新袋は一枚で瓶は持参の布袋へ移すと選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One additional bag will be enough. I have an empty cloth bag with me, so I will put the bottles in that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one new bag in Japanese and explain that you will move the bottles to the cloth bag you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。新しい袋を一枚お渡しします。ほかにお手伝いは必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Here is one new bag. Do you need any other help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: パンを新しい袋へ移す間、裂けた袋を台の上に置かせてください。あとで自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 詰替えの間は裂けた袋を台に置き後で持ち帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please let me leave the torn bag on the counter while I move the bread into the new bag. I will take it home myself afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will leave the torn bag on the counter while repacking and take it home afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結構です。お買物を全部移したら、台に忘れ物がないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. Once you have moved all your shopping, please check that you have not left anything on the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 瓶は布袋、パンは新しい袋へ移しました。レシートもあり、台に残った物はありません。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品とレシートの移動と台の忘れ物確認を終え礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have moved the bottles to the cloth bag and the bread to the new bag. I have my receipt too, and nothing is left on the counter. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have finished moving the shopping and receipt and checking the counter for anything left behind, and give thanks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care carrying your shopping home. Thank you.
